entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I'd like to return a pair of mountain bike shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. I've tried them on a few rides, and these specific cycling shoes just aren't working for me. No matter how I adjust the cleats, I'm getting terrible blisters on my heels. I'd like to get a refund if possible.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.

Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the shoes were delivered 55 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you for a full refund.

That's great news, I appreciate that. Now, since I did have to go through the trouble of trying them out and dealing with the blisters, and now calling in, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I still want to buy a different pair from you.

I'm glad I could get the return approved for you. While I can't add a promotional discount on top of the full refund, I can assure you the return process will be quick and easy. I'm generating your pre-paid return label now and will email it to you in the next few minutes.
Alright, I suppose that's fair. As long as the refund is processed, I'm happy. Please send that label over.
Of course. The email is on its way. Once we receive the shoes at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
